bio.name: Jheyson Saavedra
bio.description: I study philosophy and work with data. They're less different than most people assume.
bio.background: I've been building and programming since I was a kid, driven by curiosity about how systems behave. Now it mostly shows up as dashboards, automations, and tools I build because something was bothering me. I'm also drawn to space — probably because it's the clearest reminder of how much there is left to understand.
